recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source change is needed for FHIR-32803; future status-history work should follow FHIR-39158 and use MedicationDispense.eventHistory rather than changing this element.
issue_request: FHIR-32803 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to add MedicationDispense.statusChanged with cardinality 0..1 and datatype dateTime to record when a cancelled or declined dispense changed status.
initial_application: Commit 6cdd7b792e2241b7191584bd35915d4b0f9841f8 applied the issue by adding MedicationDispense.statusChanged to source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml. That commit also added the neighboring FHIR-32804 recorded element.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source contains MedicationDispense.statusChanged with min 0, max 1, and type dateTime. Pharmacy minutes on 2021-06-07 corroborate the 8-0-0 motion to add the date-status-changed attribute. Later FHIR-39158 resolved no-change for replacing statusChanged with statusHistory and pointed to eventHistory for full status history. Later FHIR-49940 added a cancelled-dispense example that populates statusChanged.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the authoritative current FHIR-core source already implements the requested element, cardinality, and datatype, and later related Pharmacy decisions support leaving it as-is.

related_jiras.note: Companion Pharmacy issue added MedicationDispense.recorded in the same source commit and meeting, but it is a separate timing element and already has its own audit commit.
Later Resolved - No Change decision kept statusChanged and identified MedicationDispense.eventHistory as the mechanism for complete status history.
Later Applied issue added declined/cancelled examples, including a cancelled example that uses MedicationDispense.statusChanged.
